mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.exhibition_id AS exhibitionId, e.heritage_id AS heritageId, h.name AS heritageName, e.name, e.description, e.image, e.model_path AS modelPath, e.position_x AS positionX, e.position_y AS positionY, e.position_z AS positionZ, e.category, e.era, e.origin, e.material, e.history, e.craft, e.cultural_value AS culturalValue FROM t_exhibit e LEFT JOIN t_heritage h ON e.heritage_id = h.id WHERE e.exhibition_id = #{exhibitionId} AND e.deleted_flag = 0 ORDER BY e.sort ASC

SELECT e.id, e.exhibition_id AS exhibitionId, e.heritage_id AS heritageId, h.name AS heritageName, e.name, e.description, e.image, e.model_path AS modelPath, e.position_x AS positionX, e.position_y AS positionY, e.position_z AS positionZ, e.category, e.era, e.origin, e.material, e.history, e.craft, e.cultural_value AS culturalValue FROM t_exhibit e LEFT JOIN t_heritage h ON e.heritage_id = h.id WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.deleted_flag = 0

SELECT e.id, e.exhibition_id AS exhibitionId, e.heritage_id AS heritageId, h.name AS heritageName, e.name, e.description, e.image, e.model_path AS modelPath, e.position_x AS positionX, e.position_y AS positionY, e.position_z AS positionZ, e.category, e.era, e.origin, e.material, e.history, e.craft, e.cultural_value AS culturalValue FROM t_exhibit e LEFT JOIN t_heritage h ON e.heritage_id = h.id WHERE e.deleted_flag = 0 AND e.name = #{name} LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id, e.exhibition_id AS exhibitionId, e.heritage_id AS heritageId, h.name AS heritageName, e.name, e.description, e.image, e.model_path AS modelPath, e.position_x AS positionX, e.position_y AS positionY, e.position_z AS positionZ, e.category, e.era, e.origin, e.material, e.history, e.craft, e.cultural_value AS culturalValue FROM t_exhibit e LEFT JOIN t_heritage h ON e.heritage_id = h.id WHERE e.deleted_flag = 0 AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(e.name) ASC LIMIT 1
